entities.summary: First Intifada, a transformative movement in Israel (1978–2000). Emerged from Oslo Accord and Camp David Accords — first Arab-Israeli peace treaty with Egypt. Catalyzed Oslo Accords — mutual recognition between Israel and the PLO and Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin assassinated by an Israeli extremist.
